#| echo: false
file=paste0("images/",rmarkdown::metadata$`thank-you`$file,".gif")

# {.thank-you background-image="`r file`" background="#002248" footer="false"}

```{=html}
<style>
.reveal .slide-background.thank-you .slide-background-content {
  filter: blur(4px) brightness(1);
}
</style>
```
